name: vLLM vllm/v1/sample/logits_processor/builtin.py (main) - min_p, logit bias, min_tokens processors
notes: The device-side half of logit processing, and it is a full pass over the vocab per active processor. MinPLogitsProcessor.apply does softmax(logits, dim=-1) over the whole [B, V] tensor, amax over dim=-1, a mul_, a comparison, and masked_fill_ on the logits in place - four-to-five full-width passes over V, at fp32, once per step, whenever ANY request in the batch sets min_p (gated by self.min_p_count, an O(batch) count maintained from batch add/remove/move events). LogitBiasLogitsProcessor.apply is a single scatter-add, but its state (biases dict -> three device tensors via async_tensor_h2d) is rebuilt in Python whenever any request's logit_bias changes. MinTokensLogitsProcessor mutates logits at specific ids and carries a restore_logits_slice for structured-output stop tokens. Also documents is_argmax_invariant() per processor - min_p returns True, logit_bias False - which is how engines decide whether a processor can be skipped for greedy requests.
